text: Keep the product as portable instructions plus inspectable per-case files; a framework is not a prerequisite for a credible agent.
decision_implication: Retain folder architecture; expose where evidence and decisions live.
strongest_objection: Existing frameworks already solve durable executions, tool approvals and concurrency; this recommendation stops applying if the product takes ownership of those runtime responsibilities.
limitations: Recommendation from documented mechanisms/source inspection, not a measured result on our users or agent.

text: Current Spec Kit assessment substantially overlaps the proposed discovery workflow; differentiation must be a concrete audience/job/output advantage, not merely having intake/research/decision stages.
decision_implication: Compare one actual task and artifact set against Spec Kit before claiming workflow novelty.
strongest_objection: Our audience may reject Spec Kit installation/coding-agent ceremony, and specialization can be valuable even with similar stages; overlap is not proof our product lacks demand.
limitations: Recommendation from documented mechanisms/source inspection, not a measured result on our users or agent.

text: Maintain two validation layers: deterministic file/contract checks and representative real task evaluations with ordinary-chat or old-version comparisons.
decision_implication: Judge source locators, unsupported claims, correct stop decisions and resume fidelity; do not present packaging tests or model consensus as user evidence.
strongest_objection: Live agent evaluations cost money and have stochastic/model drift; small transparent cases with human review may be more useful initially than an elaborate eval platform.
limitations: Recommendation from documented mechanisms/source inspection, not a measured result on our users or agent.

text: For the README, one truthful input→files→decision trace is more relevant than a decorative badge wall, graph platform or polished dashboard.
decision_implication: Show a concise real artifact excerpt and simple file-flow sketch with a clearly labeled result status.
strongest_objection: This is an inferred comprehension benefit, not a tested conversion/usability result; screenshots age and a clear text quickstart may suffice.
limitations: Recommendation from documented mechanisms/source inspection, not a measured result on our users or agent.

text: Repository popularity and releases provide maintenance context, not product quality proof.
decision_implication: Record version/license/maintenance ownership and inspect relevant behavior directly.
strongest_objection: Popularity may help ecosystem support/discoverability, but does not establish suitability or safety for our specific task.
limitations: Recommendation from documented mechanisms/source inspection, not a measured result on our users or agent.

text: The target job is preparing, justifying and continuing a product decision under incomplete evidence, not generating strategy prose as an end in itself.
confidence: medium for audience fit; high for supplied task interpretation
limitations: No representative PO interviews or demand validation. Target audience/JTBD inferred from task and educational artifact.
decision_implication: Lead README with recognizable decision pain, agent work, human choice, concrete result and simple real example rather than protocol vocabulary.
strongest_objection: A competent manual team or ordinary chat with equivalent tools/discipline may already satisfy this job.

text: The repository demonstrates structural decision traceability and scoped technical persistence/calculation mechanisms, not empirically established Problem–Solution Fit or quality/time/cost superiority.
limitations: One educational case, user-reported original Resume, bounded historical host observations and current CLI proof have different evidentiary strength; no representative usability or comparative TCO trial.
decision_implication: Separate realized artifacts and actual checks from hypotheses about PO workload, recommendation quality and adoption; retain human/model/cost gaps.
strongest_objection: Observable structure can provide useful auditability before market validation, even without measured superiority.
